name_en: Post Matric Scholarship (Reimbursement of Tuition Fees - RTF)
description_te: ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, PG, Professional courses చదివే విద్యార్థుల tuition fee 100% ప్రభుత్వం చెల్లిస్తుంది. DBT ద్వారా నేరుగా college కి చెల్లించబడుతుంది.
description_en: 100% tuition fee reimbursement for students pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, PG, and Professional courses. Paid directly to colleges via DBT.

eligibility_criteria.courses: ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, PG, MBA, MCA, Law
eligibility_criteria.caste: SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, Minority, Differently-abled
eligibility_criteria.land: Wetland < 10 acres or agricultural land < 25 acres
eligibility_criteria.institution: Must be studying in recognized government/private institution in AP
excluded: Students with arrears in previous year
Any family member paying income tax

benefit_amount: Full tuition fee reimbursement (varies by course: ITI ~₹10,000, Engineering ~₹35,000-₹1,00,000, Medicine ~₹5,00,000)
application_process_te:
1. College లో admission తీసుకోండి
2. JnanaBhumi portal (jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in) లో online apply చేయండి
3. Documents upload చేయండి
4. College verification తర్వాత
5. Fee నేరుగా college account కి credit అవుతుంది
go_reference: GO Ms. No. 16, dated 2020 (original); renamed under TDP government
